target: 2026-27 historical input availability; no final scoring labels

sources.paraphrase: Won and lost tackles partition total tackles. Foul-won and shot-on-target definitions specify counted player actions.

subset: With the same tackle definition, explicit total=0 proves won=0 and lost=0. Signed net then equals zero. Check source/event contradictions first.
conservation: For nonnegative player counts sharing an explicit team total, if all known player contributions sum exactly to the total, every omitted contribution must be zero. A missing team total or positive residual proves no player zero. No residual is allocated to a particular player.
mapping_qualification: Two initial and two later fixture controls per season; per-team exact conservation gates across the full historical population. Team fk_foul_won is checked against summed player wasFouled, not substituted for an individual player counter.
source_assumptions: Counts refer to the same fixture, team and full match.
Source player IDs are unique; bench and non-FPL participants remain in sums.
Existing explicit values are inputs, not overridden to force a balance.
Shared Opta ancestry and aggregate agreement do not independently verify every player value; retain the external quality caveat.
Signed raw net tackles remain separate from unqualified historical BPS clipping.
not_allowed: Blank team count interpreted as zero
Positive residual allocated to a missing player
Normalized third-party zeros treated as raw observations without transformation provenance
